periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique downward orientation at approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, converging toward the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology where the vertical axis is approximately 1.5 times the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering, with the black patch extending significantly below the eye's horizontal midline.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow and broad U-shaped curve along the posterior boundary of the transverse band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness, occupying roughly one-third of the visible torso area from the nape to the lower back.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation across the cranial crown, approximately twice the lateral width of a single ear base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Continuous, smooth semicircular curvature at the top of the pinnae.
